origin_codes.a: copied from a named source field
origin_codes.b: normalized/renamed from a named source field
origin_codes.c: derived by an explicit deterministic rule from named fields
origin_codes.d: computed from the actual media/files by a named tool
origin_codes.e: annotated/decided by a human analyst with stated evidence

source_registry.purpose: Every dataset/source considered, with official source, terms, access, size and decision.

columns.name: source_dataset_id
columns.description: Stable ORVEX id of the real-world source dataset.

columns.name: license_evidence_url
columns.lineage: URL where the licence was read

columns.name: redistribution_status
columns.description: Whether files may be redistributed (with conditions).

columns.name: real_world_eligibility
columns.description: Eligible / not eligible for the strict real-world collection and why.

columns.name: native_task
columns.description: Task the source was built for.

columns.name: media_origin_characterization
columns.description: How the media came to exist (user-uploaded, circulated, professionally edited...).

columns.name: release_size_bytes
columns.description: Total official release size when known.

real_world_media_master.purpose: Normalized master of every real-world media record (downloaded or metadata-only). Controlled variants are NOT here.

columns.name: native_record_id
columns.lineage: FVC cascade_id / FIVR query+id / VCSL uuid / ANAKIN video-id / Commons pageid

columns.name: native_media_id
columns.lineage: platform video id or file title

columns.name: source_url
columns.lineage: FVC video_url / VCSL url / ANAKIN url / Commons descriptionurl

columns.name: title
columns.description: Title if the source has one.

columns.name: publisher_account_id
columns.description: Publisher account as published; pseudonymise in reports.

columns.name: event_or_cascade_id
columns.lineage: FVC cascade_id / FIVR event id / ANAKIN video-id

columns.name: published_time_utc
columns.description: Publish time (only when the source provides one).

columns.name: observed_time_utc
columns.description: Observation time if provided by source (rare).

columns.name: normalized_authenticity_status
columns.description: unknown unless the native label states it; 'fake' in FVC = debunked, NOT AI-generated.

columns.name: coordination_status
columns.description: not_assessed for every record: no independent account/time coordination evidence exists locally.

columns.name: evidence_id
columns.description: Evidence record backing the source annotation / licence of this record.

columns.name: perceptual_hash_ref
columns.description: Reference to the computed 24-frame dHash features (local media only).

columns.name: duplicate_of_media_id
columns.description: Canonical media id if this is a duplicate.

columns.name: usable_for_variants
columns.description: Eligible as source for controlled variants.

controlled_variant_registry.purpose: Every controlled variant rendered by ORVEX from eligible real-world media. Never mixed with naturally collected media.

columns.name: direct_parent_media_id
columns.description: Immediate parent (real source or earlier variant).

columns.name: ancestor_chain
columns.description: Pipe-separated ancestors up to the root.

columns.name: video_source_media_id
columns.description: Real-world source of the picture track.

columns.name: caption_text_source_media_id
columns.description: Real-world record the caption text came from.

columns.name: caption_text_origin_field
columns.description: Field of the source record used (commons_title).

columns.name: local_path
columns.description: Path of the created file (blank for failed variants: no file retained).

columns.name: usable_for_training
columns.description: True only if passed, train split and no held-out transform in lineage.

columns.name: source_split
columns.description: Split of the root source family.

media_relationship_edges.purpose: Relationship edges: source-provided native relations (kept with original label) and controlled-transformation lineage.

columns.name: source_dataset_id
columns.description: Where the relation comes from (or ORVEX-CTRL).

columns.name: native_label
columns.lineage: FIVR ND/DS/CS/IS; VCSL label_file; FVC label; ANAKIN manipulation-type

columns.name: normalized_relation_type
columns.description: e.g. near_duplicate, partial_temporal_copy, same_scene_not_copy, same_incident_not_copy, edited_version, controlled_*.

columns.name: evidence_status
columns.description: kind of evidence behind the label: source_annotation / controlled_transformation_log (separate from label status).

platform_observations.purpose: Real posts/observations of media on platforms as provided by the sources (no invented posts).

columns.name: account_id_pseudonym
columns.lineage: SHA-256 prefix of public account name

columns.name: account_id_source_field
columns.description: Source field used (commons uploader) or null.

columns.name: order_in_cascade
columns.description: Temporal order inside cascade as stated by the authors (not a timestamp).

evidence_ledger.purpose: Evidence records supporting labels, relations and rights decisions.

columns.name: confidence_basis
columns.description: No calibrated numeric confidence; basis stated.

feature_manifest.purpose: What features actually exist (and which are not computed).

columns.name: media_id
columns.description: Media or ALL_LOCAL for aggregate rows.

columns.name: feature_type
columns.description: visual_dhash_24 / audio_pcm_md5_8k / audio_envelope_1s / visual_embedding / audio_embedding / ocr_text / asr_transcript / text_embedding / scene_boundaries.

training_pairs.purpose: Model examples (related/unrelated/uncertain pairs) with local media only, split by source family.

columns.name: relationship_id
columns.description: Edge backing the label (null for negatives).

columns.name: relationship_class
columns.description: direct_derivation / indirect_derivation / sibling_same_parent / same_family_other / edited_version / unrelated_distinct_source.

columns.name: native_label
columns.description: Native label if from a source.

campaign_candidate_clusters.purpose: Candidate clusters for human review. EMPTY: no authorised account+time evidence is available locally (see QA report).

experiment_registry.purpose: Evaluation registry. Holds only the non-learned dHash sanity baseline (BASE-DHASH-v1); no ORVEX model has been trained.

duplicate_map.purpose: Exact/near duplicates and cross-version repeats; canonical record kept.

group_examples.purpose: Groups of 6 videos (4 related family members + 2 distractors) with ground-truth edges (Module 3: compare 5-6 videos).

columns.name: truth_edges
columns.description: Nearest-selected-ancestor edges parent>child among family members.
